svg.aria-label: What I build. The kind of work, and what it is made with. Machines into screens: Cameras, scales and clocks, read in place. PYTHON · YOLO · RTSP. Real time, not refresh: Alerts reach the phone the moment they happen. SIGNALR · WEB PUSH · PWA. Reports nobody types: Excel and PDF that build themselves. CLOSEDXML · QUESTPDF · EPPLUS. Models that run on site: A local model on hardware already in the room. OLLAMA · DOCKER.
